name: default deny applies to an unknown call
policy:
version: 1
global:
  default_action: deny

name: missing version is rejected
policy:
global:
  default_action: allow

name: non-integer version is rejected
policy: version: '1'

name: unsupported future version is rejected
policy: version: 3

name: v2-only field is rejected by v1
policy:
version: 1
effects:
  audit: required

name: path and context deny match together
policy:
version: 1
agents:
  writer:
    tools:
      write_file:
        rules:
          - action: deny
            target:
              context:
                phase: prompt
            condition:
              path_pattern: /etc/*

name: global deny overrides a specific allow
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
agents:
  bot:
    tools:
      curl:
        rules:
          - action: allow

name: unknown policy field is rejected
policy:
version: 1
global:
  default_actoin: deny

name: invalid regex is rejected
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    condition:
      args_match: "["

name: Rust-only regex syntax is rejected
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    condition:
      args_match: '\p{Greek}+'

name: character classes are outside the portable regex subset
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    condition:
      args_match: '[(?=]'

name: end anchors do not match before a trailing newline
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    condition:
      args_match: '^foo$'

name: ambiguous boolean-like target is rejected
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    target:
      tool: yes

name: ambiguous timestamp-like target is rejected
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    target:
      tool: 2026-08-11

name: ambiguous sexagesimal target is rejected
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    target:
      tool: 1:20

name: ambiguous YAML 1.2 octal target is rejected
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    target:
      tool: 0o12

name: ambiguous leading-zero target is rejected
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    target:
      tool: 012

name: ambiguous exponent target is rejected
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    target:
      tool: 1e2

name: missing action has a stable error code
non-mapping target has a stable error code
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    target: []

name: non-mapping condition has a stable error code
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    condition: []

name: non-string target key has a stable error code
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    target: {1: x}

name: non-string context target key has a stable error code
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    target:
      context: {1: x}

name: non-string condition key has a stable error code
policy:
version: 1
rules:
  - action: deny
    condition: {1: x}
